payload.title: Loading LiPDverse Data and Plotting as GeoSeries
payload.description: This workflow demonstrates how to load paleoclimate datasets from the LiPDverse and create a Pyleoclim GeoSeries. It involves connecting to the LiPDverse endpoint, retrieving specified datasets, and extracting time series data to construct a GeoSeries.
